Payroll is one of the few office functions with a '''clean, published, two-stage credential ladder''' and persistent demand. The certifications are administered by '''PayrollOrg''', the professional body formerly known as the American Payroll Association.

== The two certifications ==

* '''FPC — Fundamental Payroll Certification.''' The entry credential. It is open to anyone; '''no payroll experience is required''', which is precisely what makes it useful. It is designed for people entering the field, for staff in adjacent roles — accounting clerks, human-resources assistants, benefits administrators — and for sales and systems people who support payroll products.
* '''CPP — Certified Payroll Professional.''' The senior credential, and the one that moves salary. Eligibility is '''restricted''': the issuing body publishes several qualifying routes, built around a minimum period of practice in the field and/or completion of its own course track. Candidates should read the current criteria from PayrollOrg directly, because the routes are revised periodically.

Both require '''recertification''' through continuing education, which is where [[Accreditation Bodies IACET ANSI and CHEA|CEUs]] become relevant.

== Why this is a good target ==

The work is procedural, learnable, and judged on accuracy rather than charisma. It is steady — every organisation with employees runs payroll every cycle regardless of economic conditions — and it is portable across industries, because the rules are set by tax and labour law rather than by the employer's sector.

It is also '''compatible with other work'''. The skills — scheduled data entry, reconciliation, deadline discipline, confidentiality — transfer directly from teaching (grading and records), from bookkeeping, and from any administrative role. A teacher adding an FPC has a genuine second track available during summers or as a career change, without starting from zero.

== The two-stage plan ==

The sequence that works is to '''take the FPC to get in the door''', work the required period, and '''take the CPP once eligible'''. The FPC is affordable and self-study is viable; the CPP is the one that justifies a real study investment because it changes what employers will pay.

== What to pair it with ==

* '''Spreadsheet and payroll-system proficiency''' — the practical skill employers test for, often more closely than the certificate.
* '''Bookkeeping coursework''' — widens the role to small-business accounting, where one person frequently does both.
* '''Human-resources certification''' — payroll and HR sit adjacent, and the pairing supports an operations role in a small organisation.

Related certificate paths are listed at [https://credentials.soapbox.community/industry/business-finance credentials.soapbox.community] and [https://credentials.soapbox.community/industry/human-resources credentials.soapbox.community].
